lines.text: Many learners say: He is older than me on two years.
Better: He is older than me by two years.

data.wrong: He is older than me on two years.
data.right: He is older than me by two years.

quiz.stem: I am younger than him ___ three years.

native.tip: «На два года» — “by two years”: “He is older than me by two years.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “He is older than me on two years”? 😅 По-русски «старше на два года» — с «на», и хочется сказать “on”, но разницу в английском показывает “by.” Правильно: “He is older than me by two years.” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “by.” Разница — by. Напиши своё предложение с “older than me by.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: For the gap, use “by”: “He is older than me by two years.”
en.caption: Do you also say “He is older than me on two years”? 😅 In Russian «на» shows the gap, so “on” feels right, but English uses “by.” Correct: “He is older than me by two years.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
